onboarding.gamesBody: {{games}} football quiz games, from XOX to Career Path. Play a real opponent, a friend or the bot.
onboarding.pointsBody: Win online matches to earn points in each game; your total sets your level, and a level you reach never drops. Take your place on the weekly leaderboard.
onboarding.goalsBody: You start with {{goals}} goals. Spend them on jokers in matches; the daily reward, the daily puzzle and online wins earn you more.

welcome.guestHint: Your guest account stays on this phone.
welcome.tagline: {{games}} football quiz games. Find an opponent, earn points, level up.

legal.notice: ChallengeGoal is not affiliated with any club, league, federation or footballer. Footballer images are AI-generated illustrations, not real photographs.

network.offlineHint: Check your connection. In a match you lose if you are not back within 30 seconds.

identity.failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again.

username.title: Choose your username
username.intro: Your rivals and the leaderboard will show you under this name.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.hint: Enter the e-mail address of your account. We will send a 6-digit code to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses {{email}}, we sent the code. It is valid for 15 minutes. Check your spam folder if it is not in your inbox.

register.title: Create account
register.usernameHint: Your username cannot be changed later.

home.subtitle: Name a footballer who fits both the row and the column.
home.modeFriendHint: Open a private room with a code.
home.subtitleDuel: Pick seven cards. Each round, the better card for the question scores.
home.subtitleDraft: Each round reveals a club. Add a footballer who played there to your lineup; the lineup with more career assists wins.
home.subtitleHigher: Two footballers, one question: whose goals, assists, value or age come out on top? Keep answering right to keep your turn.
home.subtitleChain: Take turns naming someone who played at the same club as the last footballer. Miss or get it wrong and you lose the round; three rounds win.
home.subtitleRare: Both of you name a footballer who fits both criteria; answers stay hidden. If both are right, the less known footballer takes the round.
home.subtitleAuction: Bid how many names you can list. The player who is told "Prove it" takes the round only by naming that many right answers in time.
home.subtitleTopTen: There is a hidden list of ten. Take turns naming players; the lower on the list, the more points. A wrong name costs a life.
home.subtitleCareer: A hidden footballer's clubs open one by one. Guess with fewer clues for more points; a wrong guess opens a new club and passes the turn.
home.puzzleHint: Everyone gets the same grid · 9 guesses

match.bySecondMove: All level, second to move wins
match.cellsDecide: No line is possible any more. Most cells wins.
match.bySpeed: Scores level, the faster player wins

account.title: Account
account.offlineHint: The server could not be reached. Offline play still works.
account.guestNote: To create an account or sign in, sign out first. Your guest account stays on this phone and opens again when you continue as guest.
account.deleteMessage: Your account, points, level, goals and match history are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteGuestMessage: Your guest account, points, level, goals and match history are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted. Check your connection and try again.

online.searchingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.
online.roomHint: Your friend enters this code to join.

friend.title: Play a friend
friend.createHint: You get a code to share with your friend.

credits.title: Image sources
credits.intro: Player images are AI-generated illustrations made from freely licensed photos on Wikimedia Commons; they are not real photographs. Each illustration is shared under the same licence as its source photo.
credits.empty: There are no portraits in this version yet.

duel.pickHint: You pick before you know the questions: goals, assists, matches, age… anything can come up.
duel.questionMarketValue: The higher peak market value wins

draft.searchEmpty: No footballer fits your open slots. Only players with assist data are listed.

higher.questionMarketValue: Whose peak market value was higher?

chain.rule: Name someone who played at the same club as the last footballer
chain.scope: The shared club must be in the Süper Lig or one of Europe's big five leagues. A name cannot be said twice in a round.

rare.rule: Name a footballer who fits both. The less known right answer takes the round.
rare.name: Name a footballer

auction.rule: How many footballers fitting both can you name? Your opponent raises or says "Prove it". If your time runs out, you say "Prove it".
auction.name: Name a footballer

topTen.listValue: Top 10 {{name}} footballers by peak market value
topTen.listClubGoals: Top 10 career scorers who played for {{name}}
topTen.rule: Rankings follow the app's data. Number 10 is worth 10 points, number 1 is worth 1; a wrong name costs a life.

career.question: Who is this footballer?
career.rule: Clubs open in the order they were joined. Get it now for {{points}} points.
career.scope: Only clubs of the Süper Lig and Europe's big five leagues are shown.

leave.title: Leave the match?
leave.message: If you leave, the match counts as a loss.
leave.messageRanked: If you leave, the match counts as a loss and you lose points in this game.

reward.unrankedHint: Points and goals are earned only in "Online match" games.
reward.protectHint: Watch an ad and get back the {{points}} points you lost.
reward.protectPending: Your points will be back in a moment.

progress.open: Level {{level}}, {{points}} points. Open history and stats.

store.hint: Spend goals on jokers during matches.

store.guest: You need a member account to buy goals. Sign out on the account screen and create one; points and goals of the guest account do not move to the new account.
store.offline: You need to be online to use the store.
store.payment: You pay with your {{store}} account. Goals are added to your account right after the purchase.
store.adSpent: Done for today. Come back tomorrow.
store.adUnavailable: No ad right now. Tap to try again.
store.adPending: Your reward will be added in a moment.

daily.title: Daily reward
daily.hint: Come back every day to grow your streak. From day 7 on, 5 goals a day.
daily.welcomeHint: Spend goals on jokers during matches.

puzzle.title: Daily puzzle
puzzle.rule: Fill each cell with a footballer who fits its row and column. You have 9 guesses; a wrong guess uses one too. The fewer people give the same answer, the more points.
